title: EMV KFT transaction outcome
description: Schema for EMV Known Fare Transaction (KFT) outcome messages published by validator.

deviceId.description: Unique device identifier of the validator.

requestId.description: The traceId from the request message (start, cancel, or abort) that triggered this outcome.

requestType.description: Type of the EMV transaction request that this outcome corresponds to.

status.description: Final outcome status of the transaction.

result.description: Detailed result of the transaction, when applicable.

rejectReason.description: Reason for rejection if status is 'rejected'.

tapId.description: Unique identifier of the EMV tap event.

cardAid.description: Application Identifier (AID) of the EMV card.

cardAtc.description: Application Transaction Counter (ATC) of the EMV card.

maskedPan.description: Masked Primary Account Number (PAN). Shows partial digits with asterisks for privacy. Common formats: last 4 only (************1234), BIN + last 4 (123456******1234), or first 4 + last 4 (1234********1234).

eventTimestamp.description: Timestamp of when the outcome was produced.
